user_instruction: Give a standalone Python file implementing the proposed model end to end and a GPU operator prompt.
authorization: Implementation and publication requested; cluster launch to be performed by the user/operator, not this workstation.
code_commit: Exact published commit supplied in delivery; record git rev-parse HEAD from the immutable checkout in each launch.
hypothesis: Class/condition-conditioned joint contribution alignment plus a worst-condition soft-error disparity penalty improves matched fairness without violating predeclared utility floors.
changed_from_historical_R1: Class/group cell batches instead of weighted individual sampling
Three independent canonical conditions in every arm
Explicit fairness selection with fixed utility floors instead of AUC-only selection
New alignment and condition-gap objectives only in designated arms
dependencies: TRAIN/VAL manifests, declared split overlap and immutable image storage
One scheduler-allocated GPU with verified binding
required_checks: Preflight fixed group/class support and provenance
CUDA synthetic smoke on actual cluster environment
Configured real batch dry run with finite gradients and unchanged weights/buffers
Matched BCE and full selected-checkpoint independent validation replay
test_policy: No test reads during training/selection; explicit later test evaluation uses frozen validation threshold.
